title: Northgate Credit Cards Earning Rate Schedule
content:
The reward rates of Northgate Credit Cards are set per card product and per earning category. Rates are percentages of qualifying spend. The gas and EV charging cap is an amount of qualifying gas and EV charging spend in a reward year, not an amount of reward: spend up to the cap earns the gas and EV charging rate, and spend beyond it earns the beyond-cap rate.

## Rates by card product

| Card product | Gas and EV charging | Gas and EV charging spend per reward year earning that rate (cap) | Gas and EV charging beyond the cap | Restaurants | Travel | Northgate purchases, in clubs and online | All other purchases |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | 0% | $0.00 | 0% | 0% | 0% | 1% | 0% |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 0% | $0.00 | 0% | 0% | 0% | 1% | 0% |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 4% | $7000.00 | 1% | 3% | 3% | 2% | 1% |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 4% | $7000.00 | 1% | 3% | 3% | 2% | 1% |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 5% | $8000.00 | 1% | 3% | 3% | 3% | 1% |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 5% | $8000.00 | 1.5% | 3% | 3% | 3% | 1.5% |

## Northgate Fuel Center purchases

| Card product | Earning category of Northgate Fuel Center purchases |
|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | Northgate purchases |
| Northgate Business Store Card | Northgate purchases |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Gas and EV charging |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Gas and EV charging |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Gas and EV charging |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | Gas and EV charging |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which rate a Northgate Fuel Center purchase takes.** On either store card it earns as a Northgate purchase, so at 1%. On a Rewards Visa product it earns as gas and EV charging, so at that card's gas and EV charging rate (4% or 5%) up to the cap and at its beyond-cap rate after it.
- **Where the Rewards Visa products differ.** The Signature and Business cards share every rate. The Signature Plus card raises gas and EV charging to 5% with an $8000.00 cap and Northgate purchases to 3%. The Business Plus card has the same figures as the Signature Plus card except that gas and EV charging beyond the cap and all other purchases earn 1.5% rather than 1%.
- **Store cards.** Both store cards show 0% in every category other than Northgate purchases, and a cap of $0.00.

## Rate look-ups (illustrative)

- A Northgate club purchase on a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus: Northgate purchases, 3%.
- A restaurant meal on a Northgate Rewards Visa Business: restaurants, 3%.
- An airline ticket on a Northgate Business Store Card: travel, 0%.
- A purchase at a hardware store (all other purchases) on a Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus: 1.5%.
